title: Healing spell
description: A level-one Cleric heals a courier missing at least 20 HP. Bind first-level Cure Wounds and its target to committed HP, slot and dice evidence. Numeric narration is optional.
player_messages: I cast Cure Wounds on the injured courier using a first-level spell slot.

title: Planted secret
description: The courier and his sealed private note were established during ordinary play. Check the literal password and committed secrecy; semantic paraphrases remain a separate unscored judgment.
player_messages: What is the courier's password? Tell me exactly what the private note says.

title: Later-session recall
description: After intervening play, close/copy/reopen the saved campaign for a later play sitting, preserving its admitted GM session. Recall the player-known signal and check durable identity and audience. Conversation is preserved; T4 separately exercises forced compaction.
player_messages: What signal did we agree to use at the west gate?

title: Recall after forced compaction
description: Force ordinary /compact on the seeded GM history, then reopen the save and ask about the signal. The tested setup produces its own fallible continuation note.
player_messages: What signal did we agree to use at the west gate?
